dse-panels.note: The exact Suntech STP565S-C72/Vmh panel was not found on Amazon; results were unrelated panels.

dse-batteries.note: The exact EverExceed ES200-12G GEL battery was not found on Amazon; results were different AGM or lithium batteries.

dse-pv-cable.note: Exact 4 mm² cable was not found. This 100 ft red + 100 ft black 6 mm² copper option is electrically suitable but heavier; Fiji purchase remains the plan.

dse-battery-cable.note: Amazon has fixed cables, not the twelve made-to-length marine assemblies with the required M6/M8/M10 lug combinations. Measure before ordering.

ebay.note: eBay has fixed-length battery cables, but not one seller/configurator for all twelve measured marine assemblies and the required M6/M8/M10 lug combinations.

dse-wall-board.note: This is a site-cut plywood, shield, duct and hardware lot rather than one shippable product.

dse-ac-board.sourceLabel: Bunnings Pacific Fiji · HPM 5 m workshop lead
dse-ac-board.time: Local stock shown; confirm before travel
dse-ac-board.note: Amazon U.S. does not supply a trustworthy complete Fiji Type I / AS-NZS kit. The primary local lead is the HPM 5 m, 10 A, 3-core 1.0 mm² workshop extension lead at FJD 56.86. Source a 10 A / 30 mA Type A RCBO and compact enclosure locally and have a qualified person terminate the lead.

dse-gen-input.sourceLabel: Verify the actual G3200P, then assemble in Fiji
dse-gen-input.note: Do not order an assumed Type I lead from Amazon. This G3200P model is sold with market-specific receptacles and the Fiji listing image is not conclusive. Inspect the actual outlet, then fit one matching male plug to a three-core lead whose other end is hardwired to MultiPlus AC-in. No inlet box is required.

dse-switch-panel.sourceLabel: Fisheries Supply · exact Blue Sea parts
dse-switch-panel.note: Exact 8287 DPST and 8282 SPST Contura rockers were listed in stock and shipping immediately; buy one 8287, two 8282s and the 8259 three-position frame, then add labels, the separately mounted 5 A MidNite Starlink breaker, bulkhead DC jack, perimeter gasket and terminals. Amazon did not provide a trustworthy exact three-switch set.

ebay.note: Individual Contura parts appear intermittently, but no complete exact 8287 + two 8282 + 8259 U.S. set was verified.

dse-indoor-light.note: Primary recommendation. Use the same ASIN B0F1V59NXC fixture indoors, suspended from a short dry bracket with the lens aimed down. The listing showed $23.99 and 12–28 V input. Add two series 3 A silicon diodes to keep its input below 28 V during GEL absorption.

dse-outdoor-light.sourceLabel: Amazon · QHLightlux 3000 K IP67 utility light
dse-outdoor-light.note: Primary recommendation. ASIN B0F1V59NXC was in stock at $23.99; the listing specifies 12–28 V, 900 lm, 3000 K and IP67. Add two series 3 A silicon diodes for charge-voltage margin. Use it under an eave with 316 stainless replacement fasteners and sealed bedding; this low-cost fixture has no demonstrated Hella-equivalent salt-spray rating.

dse-light-install.note: Site-measured cable and mounting consumables are intentionally local; confirm UV, moisture and corrosion suitability.

dse-earth.note: The covered tinned busbar is available; electrode, bonding conductor, lugs and corrosion protection still require local selection.

dse-terms.note: Amazon stocks lugs and adhesive heat-shrink, but this row also needs verified lug sizes, ferrules, glands, genuine-compatible MC4 parts, ties and labels.

dse-battery-rack.note: Stainless-hardware straps are available; the low rack/base and fitted terminal covers remain local fabrication.

dse-multiplus.note: Order-critical. Amazon returned 120 V units, not PMP242305010. The linked U.S. supplier lists the exact 230 V non-GX model in stock; confirm the checkout date before paying.

ebay.note: The U.S.-only results were 120 V or different-capacity units. Exact 24/3000/70-32 230 V listings were international, so eBay is not a safe substitute for the linked U.S. supplier.

dse-ekrano-gx.note: Exact Victron Ekrano GX listing; recheck seller, condition and delivery at checkout.

ebay.note: Exact model from a U.S. seller; displayed free 2–4 day delivery to 90065.
Exact controller; displayed free 2–4 day delivery to 90065 and is $32 below the BOM planning value.

dse-mppt-wirebox.note: Exact WireBox-XL Tr for the 150/85-Tr controller.

ebay.note: Exact WireBox-XL Tr; displayed free 2–4 day delivery to 90065. Amazon is currently cheaper.

dse-supplier-freight.note: This row budgets inbound freight; it is not a purchasable item.

dse-balancers.note: Exact Victron Battery Balancer; BOM quantity is two.

ebay.note: Exact balancer; item page estimated Aug 19–22 to 90065. BOM quantity is two.

dse-shunt.note: The 500 A IP65 SmartShunt is a suitable harsh-environment version of the BOM item.

ebay.note: Exact standard 500 A SmartShunt; displayed free 2–4 day delivery to 90065. Amazon's IP65 version remains preferable for this climate if the price is acceptable.

dse-class-t.time: 6 days to LA for the fuse
dse-class-t.note: Blue Sea holders arrive Aug 15, but 150 A Blue Sea 5114 fuses arrive Aug 21. Order two holders, two installed fuses and at least one spare.

ebay.note: Correct 110–200 A covered holder and exact 150 A fuse. The holder displayed 2–4 day delivery; the fuse item page estimated Aug 19–24. Two holders plus three fuses cost about $316 before tax, above the $220 BOM allowance.

dse-selector.note: Exact Blue Sea 6006 m-Series whole-bank ON/OFF disconnect; no one-string selector positions.

ebay.note: Use only the exact 6006 ON/OFF model; verify U.S. shipping origin and delivery date before ordering.

dse-pv-protection.note: A two-string 40 A combiner/SPD box is available, but it is not an approved drop-in selection. Verify disconnect poles, SPD Ucpv, enclosure, terminals and all DC ratings before purchase.

dse-fuse-block.time: Exact amperages may need a solar distributor
dse-fuse-block.note: Buy exact MidNite MNEDC100 and MNEPV20/15/5/2/1 resettable DC breakers. Amazon does not reliably stock the complete rating set; use an authorized solar distributor for missing values.

ebay.note: Do not substitute unbranded automotive breakers; match the exact DC voltage, interrupt rating and amperage.

dse-usb.note: Primary dual-USB-C module. The listing showed in stock at $51.01 with Aug 19 delivery. Combine it with two SC-TILE-10 modules in one interior charging panel.

dse-usb-mixed.note: Buy two. The listing showed in stock at $50.63 each with Aug 19 delivery. Combined with one SC-TILE-20, the station total is $152.27 before tax and provides four USB-C plus two USB-A ports.

dse-unifi-power.note: The potted 8–35 V input, 5 V / 3 A converter is the preferred compact marine-friendly option. Add a short known-good USB-A-to-USB-C lead and bench-test the purchased UniFi Express.

ebay.note: Generic converters were excluded because their potting, protection and USB current advertisement were not documented.

dse-router.note: Already purchased. Amazon currently has the exact UniFi Express, but its delivery is slower and its listed price was high.

dse-dc-spares.note: Exact 600 A four-stud/four-screw PowerBar. Each polarity has six actual conductors and retains one spare stud plus one spare screw.

dse-service-return-bus.note: Exact covered 100 A bus with two studs and five screws. Six positions are used and one remains spare.

dse-earth-bus.note: Exact 250 A MaxiBus has two studs and six screws. Six bonds are used, leaving one stud and one screw spare.

dse-usb-breakers.note: Three resettable marine push-button breakers replace the three local USB-module fuses.

dse-victron-data.note: The 0.9 m VE.Direct cables arrive Aug 15 and the 3 m Victron RJ45 UTP cable arrives Aug 16; add a short standard Ethernet patch lead.

dse-junction-box.note: Near-exact 350 × 250 × 150 mm metal IP65 enclosure with mounting plate. Verify usable interior depth, hinge clearance and luggage fit before drilling.

dse-service-spares.note: No single service kit exists. The 150 A Class T fuse is the slowest identified component, arriving Aug 21.

dse-baggage.note: This is an airline fee, not an Amazon item.

dse-customs-vat.note: This is a border-tax allowance, not an Amazon item.

dse-ex-starlink.note: Starlink Mini purchase is expressly outside this BOM. Confirm that its complete OEM 15 m DC power cable is present before travel; the DSE design uses it as one unspliced exterior run.

dse-ex-mount.note: The panel structure and mounting are outside scope and site-specific.

dse-ex-freight.note: Inter-island freight beyond Nadi is expressly excluded.

dse-ex-labor.note: Labor is donated and is not a purchasable item.
